notes: Linux ScopedOwnedTasksV1: an in-scope second-creation error handler joins the first child, drops its returned Buffer and rethrows the bound payload-free SpawnError. Four native/reference scenarios cover success, allocation failure and each creation failure with exact buffer/environment identities and join-before-reclamation checks. Omitting the sibling join or returned-buffer drop rejects at Q600. Owned error payloads, loans, arbitrary handlers, worker allocation and native refinement proofs remain open.

diagnostic.message_contains: return/error discards a handle, unconsumed Result or owned buffer
